title: GitLab Patches Max-Severity Vulnerability CVE-2026-97229

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hackers hit French supermarkets via unpatched Danfoss refrigeration systems, remote-heating freezers and destroying stock worth millions. Overnight from Sunday to Monday, a large cyberattack hit the refrigeration systems of hundreds of French supermarkets, BFMTV revealed. The attackers targeted equipment from the Danish maker Danfoss that many French stores use to regulate their cold. Fresh and […]
title: Hackers cranked French supermarkets’ freezers up to 50 degrees, causing hundreds of stores to lose their stock
